metrics.answerText:
## Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict

I read all three dossiers at the [recall brief](http://127.0.0.1:34637/recall-brief) and opened each one's linked independent lab report.

### ✅ Supported: bearing seat machining
- Dossier: [theory-bearing](http://127.0.0.1:34637/theory-bearing) — recalled widgets may have had bearing seats machined out of tolerance.
- [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35491/lab-bearing): **"Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED."**
- **Decisive measurement:** bearing seats 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch.

### ❌ Ruled out: ceramic coating cure
- Dossier: [theory-coating](http://127.0.0.1:34637/theory-coating) — matte ceramic coat possibly cured too fast.
- [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35491/lab-coating): "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."
- **Ruled out because:** cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch.

### ❌ Ruled out: packaging compression
- Dossier: [theory-packaging](http://127.0.0.1:34637/theory-packaging) — widgets possibly compressed in transit by undersized packaging.
- [Lab report](http://127.0.0.2:35491/lab-packaging): "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."
- **Ruled out because:** packaging matched spec on every recalled batch.
